findings.finding_and_evidence: `TopDown3DInteractionController.FindBestTarget` explicitly searches Ironstone, harvester, camp and cache components. An interface-only chair/ladder will not appear.
findings.plan_correction: One target descriptor/query path, registration/deduplication and target-owned collider checks in FND2.

findings.finding_and_evidence: `TopDown3DPlayerActionController.TryBeginTarget` dispatches the special types, then enters the reward-oriented gather state.
findings.plan_correction: Explicit station-action dispatch before legacy gathering; no fake reward/consume adapters.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Motor `IsActionConstrained` returns early, zeros planar velocity and publishes a zero-motion snapshot.
findings.plan_correction: Owned motion modes must advance inside the motor and publish actual motion/posture to presentation.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Cargo/camp gates use legacy `IsGathering`/placement flags; waiting for Legger can be busy without a motor constraint.
findings.plan_correction: Shared activity projection covers legacy work and new actions; retain the motor lease as motion authority.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Controls preferences whitelist active actions and check conflicts only against that list plus Move/CameraLookAhead. Menu configuration defaults to the global preference directory.
findings.plan_correction: Lab commands enter the coactive conflict policy; inject a distinct controls directory and use an owned runtime asset instance.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Menu/camp/inventory already own input modes, EventSystem references and release gating.
findings.plan_correction: Host the action palette in the existing menu owner; one modal owner, no parallel UI input stack.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Legacy gait timing/foot contacts continue inside the animation driver; a new mixer branch alone does not switch contact authority.
findings.plan_correction: Explicit pose/clock/contact routing; one physical effect ledger, no inactive-gait footsteps.

findings.finding_and_evidence: `Test-LocalWorkspace.ps1` and `repo-health.sh` reject orphan `.meta` files. Previously planned public FBX metadata would orphan on a clone without private payloads.
findings.plan_correction: Keep restricted payload and paired metadata together privately; track folder scaffolding, GUID/import receipts and recipes publicly. Hydration preserves GUIDs.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Read-only FBX import found 30 finger bones in the original 74-bone rig and the 102-bone re-export, versus eight index-chain bones in the Mixamo rig.
findings.plan_correction: Compare source and target rigs before contact authoring. Separate source/target Avatars for differing hierarchies; fuller bones still need authored grip poses.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Phase mapping explicitly orders R0 → L0 → R1 → L1. The profiler is bound to the canonical model/profile and its measurement helper is private.
findings.plan_correction: Add a parameterized calibrated preview fixture and validate cross-foot cyclic order, units and source phase normalization, not only two contacts per foot.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Motor nominal non-sprint speed is 4.2; keyboard movement is full magnitude. Existing art has no upright backward locomotion or standing turn-in-place set.
findings.plan_correction: Add a lab walk modifier and motion-role gaps. Facing-independent movement must not silently play forward clips while backpedalling.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Pickup/throw sources exist, but carry/hold/place sequences and persistent held-object presentation are not defined.
findings.plan_correction: Require a qualified stationary hold plus safe drop; enable walking with held props only after carry poses/locomotion qualify.

findings.finding_and_evidence: No corpse collider, airborne fatal exit or posture-compatible get-up/death policy is implemented.
findings.plan_correction: Define collision/gravity and damage policy by posture, terminal hold, clearance-tested recovery and reset. No initial ragdoll requirement.

findings.finding_and_evidence: The save service captures survival and actor transforms on a safe 30-second timer and quit; menu controls save separately.
findings.plan_correction: Apply scene session policy before restore/writer startup; independently isolate lab controls. Test autosave/manual/disable/quit and file byte preservation.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Broader Downloads scan found two byte-distinct sprint export attempts omitted from the folder-only map.
findings.plan_correction: Account for all aliases and preserve the two versions outside Unity imports. Their sampled frame poses match the retained sprint reference.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Chair/ground/sleep loops do not form complete enter/exit sets; existing camp clips are separate configured assets with their own placement/equipment lifecycle.
findings.plan_correction: Assign per-role acquisition/adaptation and family exit gates. Do not drive a bedroll by two competing camp/action owners.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Existing scene tests open/clear scenes and install runtime UI; the profiler creates a preview scene.
findings.plan_correction: Separate read-only loaded-scene checks from disposable fixture tests. Hydrated validation copies need approved ownership and capacity.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Sprint auto-vault/steep-climb, capsule support and gravity already live in the motor.
findings.plan_correction: Define arbitration with crouch/slide/ladder/cover; probe shapes and support must use current posture.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Markers can cross on long frames, loops, pause, cancel and preview seek; “exactly once” was stated without a full clock/commit contract.
findings.plan_correction: Pure marker/transaction ledger, action epochs, bounded cycle effects and FixedUpdate commits before family implementation.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Mounting and wall/crowd alternatives were deferred “if still wanted,” although they came from the author’s requested animation list.
findings.plan_correction: Keep them as requested gap closure, distinct from optional polish. Define an initial candidate milestone and a later complete requested milestone.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Existing algae drink/eat/treat and companion/item interactions have little or no dedicated player animation presentation.
findings.plan_correction: Record unarmed use-item, carry and environment-inspection roles in a prioritized backlog; preserve existing transaction ownership.

findings.finding_and_evidence: Previous batch 2 required animation/contact qualification before the generic fixture, action contracts and scene safety existed.
findings.plan_correction: Reorder into independent foundation gates, minimal rig qualification, bulk import/profile qualification, then player/station families.
